offering_description.value: Provides equipment and services for drilling, evaluation, completion, production and intervention of oil and gas wells. Sells to national, international and independent oil and gas operators. Delivers through engineered tools, manufacturing and field service crews.

primary_products.value: managed pressure drilling systems; drilling tools and drill bits; artificial lift systems; completion equipment and liner hangers; wellhead and tubular running equipment

primary_services.value: well construction and drilling services; wireline and formation evaluation; well completions; well intervention; production optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: national oil companies, international oil majors and independent exploration and production operators

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; geothermal; energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: field services such as drilling, evaluation, intervention and well testing; product sales: drilling, completion and artificial lift equipment; rental or leasing: rental of tools and equipment used downhole
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs well construction, evaluation, completion and intervention services for oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures downhole tools and production equipment sold to energy operators

geography_served.value: global: Operations in North America, Latin America, Middle East, North Africa, Europe, Asia Pacific and Russia

specialization.value: related lines: drilling, evaluation, completion, intervention and production equipment and services for oil and gas wells

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts and tenders with national and international oil and gas operators; own locations: regional service bases, manufacturing sites and field operations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oilfield operations subject to environmental, health and safety rules, plus export controls and sanctions regimes
